summary: Perry County ridge lookout site, used in the early 1900s and no longer standing; registered with FFLOS in 2008. No source found describes the site today.

notes_for_editor: Only one history sentence was found: the register says the tower was used in the early 1900s and is no longer standing. No build date, staffing, fire or removal date was found in the register, the Weebly lookout index (its Amberson entry reads 'No information'), or two search rounds, which returned only topographic and index pages. The story is short for that reason; a later pass could check Pennsylvania forestry reports or Perry County newspapers. Access and the site today are not described by any source read.
